title: Silver ETF vs Physical Silver: Which Is Right for Your Portfolio?
description: SLV charges 0.50% annually and taxes gains at 28%. Physical silver costs more upfront but you own it outright. A practical comparison of counterparty risk, tax treatment, storage, and liquidity for new silver buyers.
alt: Silver ETF vs physical silver comparison: SLV 0.50% annual fee, 28% collectibles tax rate on both, PSLV 0.35% fee
